name: taskpulse-baileys-integration
description: WhatsApp read-only task extraction for TaskPulse

notes.baileys_version: Use exactly @whiskeysockets/baileys — the official maintained fork. Do NOT use any other baileys forks.
notes.node_version: Requires Node 18+. Do NOT use Bun — Baileys is unstable on Bun.
notes.anti_ban: The service is read-only by design. Never call sock.sendMessage() from this service.
